class.name: TrainUniversalController
class.brief_description: Represents the universal controller in a train.
class.description: [TrainUniversalController] wraps the FIZ [code]UCList:[/code] section - a combined traction/braking controller used on vehicles with [code]EngineType=DieselElectric[/code] or [code]EngineType=ElectricInductionMotor[/code]. It groups positions that map to both traction and braking states.

members.member: [code]UCList:IntegratedBrake[/code] Whether the ED/HD/auxiliary pneumatic brake is supported on this controller.
[code]UCList:IntegratedBrakePN[/code] Whether the train's (automatic) pneumatic brake is supported on this controller.
[code]UCList[/code] The controller's position table. Each item's index corresponds to the position number (column A in the wiki table), starting from 0.
The current position of the controller selector.
